title: Patch 0.2.2 for Wings of Paper is now live!
author: Mithila Games Staff
content: A new patch is now live for Wings of Paper on Android! This update fixes major collision bugs in the forest environment, improves flight controls responsiveness, and optimizes performance for low-end devices. Download the update today on the Google Play Store.

title: PEAK: The Mountain Adventure arrives on Android & PC
author: Mithila Games Staff
content: Scale massive peaks and brave the elements in PEAK: The Mountain Adventure, now available for Android and PC. Manage your stamina, explore hidden trails, and survive extreme weather in our brand new story-driven exploration game.
